plugin_description: Play Wallpaper Engine wallpapers from the Steam Workshop, with palette sync, timed cycling and rejection of the ones that saturate the GPU.

panel.title: b3l0w wallpaper
panel.stop_tooltip: Stop the wallpaper on this output and restore the previous Noctalia wallpaper
panel.select_multiple_tooltip: Pick several wallpapers and cycle through them on a timer
panel.cycle_needs_selection: Select at least one wallpaper before starting a cycle
panel.list_failed: Could not list the Wallpaper Engine library
panel.no_properties: This wallpaper exposes no configurable properties
panel.unlabeled: Show {count} options the author left unnamed
panel.missing_item: That wallpaper is no longer in the library
panel.engine_scope: Applies to Wallpaper Engine and 3D scenes. Videos use mpvpaper with their own options.
panel.props_hint: Enter saves and relaunches. Empty = project value.

engine.title: Engine
engine.no_fullscreen_pause: Keep playing when an app is fullscreen
engine.fullscreen_pause_only_active: Pause only for the active fullscreen window
engine.clear_overrides: Also clear per-wallpaper overrides for the settings changed here

gpu.title: GPU load
gpu.blocked: {name} was not applied: it is blocked for saturating the GPU
gpu.marked_body: {busy}% of the sampling window with the GPU busy
gpu.reason_gpu: Blocked automatically: GPU load above the threshold
gpu.explainer: Load is measured, never guessed from the wallpaper type: the engine counts how long the GPU spent out of RC6 while the wallpaper was on screen, over a {sample} ms window that starts after a {warmup} ms warm-up.
gpu.unavailable: This GPU does not expose RC6 counters, so automatic detection stays off
gpu.dump_desc: Writes state, catalog, live processes and the tail of engine.log.

grid_columns.label: Wallpapers per row
grid_columns.description: How many wallpapers a grid row shows. The panel has a fixed size, so fewer columns means larger previews.

default_view.label: View on open
default_view.description: Carousel pages through the library a screen at a time; grid scrolls the whole library vertically.

sync_colors.label: Sync shell colors with the wallpaper
sync_colors.description: Generate the Noctalia palette from the wallpaper being applied, the way an ordinary wallpaper does. Uses the Workshop preview, or a decoded frame when ffmpeg is installed.

gpu_threshold.label: GPU load threshold
gpu_threshold.description: A wallpaper is rejected when the GPU stays at or above this share of the sampling window. Raise it to keep heavier wallpapers.

probe_warmup_ms.label: Warm-up before measuring
probe_warmup_ms.description: Time the wallpaper gets on screen before the counters are read, so shader compilation is not charged to it.

probe_sample_ms.label: Sampling window
probe_sample_ms.description: How long the GPU counters are read. Short windows are noisy, long ones make a full measurement pass slow.

images_dir.label: Images folder
images_dir.description: Folder scanned by the local images mode.

videos_dir.label: Videos folder
videos_dir.description: Folder scanned by the local videos mode (played with mpvpaper).

wallhaven_api_key.label: Wallhaven API key
wallhaven_api_key.description: Optional. Without a key the search only returns SFW results.

scan_depth.label: Subfolder depth
scan_depth.description: How many subfolder levels the local modes scan.

animations.label: Animations
animations.description: Turn off on slower machines to save CPU.

video_loop.label: Loop
video_loop.description: Restarts the video when it ends.

video_mute.label: Mute
video_mute.description: Does not play the video audio.

video_hwdec.label: Hardware decoding
video_hwdec.description: Decodes with the GPU; much lower cost on 4K.

video_options.label: Extra mpv options
video_options.description: Space separated mpv flags, passed through as-is.

carousel_spacing.label: Spacing between cards
carousel_spacing.description: 0 keeps them glued, 100 spreads them the most.

download_dir.label: Download folder
download_dir.description: Where to save Wallhaven wallpapers. Empty = plugin data folder.

wallhaven_max.label: Wallhaven
wallhaven_max.description: How many Wallhaven wallpapers to load (24 per page)

debug.label: Debug mode
debug.description: Writes detailed traces to the log: every IPC action, process spawn, scan and error with context.

layout.apply_on_desc: Output selector in the header, in every mode.
layout.view_label_desc: Off leaves only the icon of the carousel/grid switch.
layout.style_hint: Full: captions and counters · Minimal: the image and nothing else
